title: E3-Lin to E3-Sat instance reduction
statement: Every E3-Lin instance over $\mathbb{F}_2$ is sent to an E3-Sat instance on the same variables by replacing each linear constraint with its four-clause multiset. The resulting instance has at least one constraint, and every declared variable occurs in the scope of some constraint.
